extracted.name: Braised Collard Greens
extracted.description: This recipe for braised collard greens simmers them in stock with ham hocks, salt pork, bay leaves, red pepper flakes, and sugar until tender and delicious.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds collard greens - rinsed, stemmed and thinly sliced
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Add chicken stock, ham hocks, salt pork, onion, bay leaves, sugar, and pepper flakes to a large pot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer; simmer for 30 minutes.
Add collard greens to the pot; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer; simmer until greens are tender, about 30 minutes. Season with vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
